description: Defines the ta_management_system class and ue_ta_manager class for managing timing advance in a wireless communication system, including data structures, methods for handling UEs, timing advance measurements, and related configurations.

classes.name: ta_management_system
classes.description: Manages timing advance for multiple UEs, including measurement collection, timing adjustment, and scheduling.

classes.name: ue_ta_manager
classes.description: Provides an interface to manage timing advance for a single UE, including updating tags and handling N_TA updates.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the timing advance management system.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles timing advance tasks at each slot indication.

methods.name: nof_active_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of active UEs managed.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the system.

methods.name: handle_ue_ta_cmds
methods.description: Processes pending timing advance commands for a UE.

methods.name: compute_avg_n_ta_difference
methods.description: Computes the average N_TA difference from measurements.

methods.name: compute_new_t_a
methods.description: Calculates a new Timing Advance Command value based on N_TA difference.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Updates TAG IDs for a UE.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the TA manager for a UE.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Checks if TA management is active for a UE.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Updates TAG IDs for the UE.

methods.name: handle_ul_n_ta_update_indication
methods.description: Handles uplink N_TA update indication for a UE.
